headline: Last session: Nifty reclaims 23,000 as Sensex rises 308 points; IndiGo and HCLTech among top gainers

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 2 November.

why: Nifty reclaimed the 23,000 mark during the last trading session on Friday
The Sensex gained 308 points driven by strong performance in large-cap stocks
Positive sentiment was supported by the government releasing an additional ₹1.09 lakh crore tax devolution to states
FMCG and financial sectors rallied in recent sessions, providing a boost to the benchmarks
whatHappening: The NSE and BSE are closed today, November 1, for the weekend
In the last session, the Sensex settled at 74,459.53 while the Nifty 50 gained 0.51%
Midcap and smallcap stocks underperformed the broader market indices on Friday
Analysts are looking ahead to the November 2-6 week for a potential Diwali market rebound
summary: The Indian stock market is closed today for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday. In the last session, the Nifty reclaimed the 23,000 level while the Sensex gained over 300 points, led by gains in IndiGo and HCLTech. Despite the positive close in benchmarks, mid and small-cap segments saw some underperformance.
